meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上「customize」后，当你想给 NanoClaw 增加新聊天渠道、改变触发规则或接入新服务时，它会先提问确认需求，再实际修改配置，完成后告诉你怎样验证是否生效。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Telegram、Slack 等新渠道，或要求改触发词、加集成、调整路由等定制功能时触发。

say.text: 我想给 NanoClaw 接入 Telegram 输入渠道。
say.note: 它会问你连到哪个 agent group、隔离级别等问题。

say.text: 把这个群的触发词改成“hey bot”。
say.note: 它会调整该群的触发规则。

say.text: 给技术组这个 agent group 加上日历工具。
say.note: 可能调用 /add-gcal-tool 完成接入。

howto.what_en: After installing 'customize', when you want to add a new chat channel to NanoClaw, change trigger rules, or connect an external service, it first asks clarifying questions, then makes the configuration change, and finally tells you how to verify it works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add an input channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or request any other customization.

say_en.text: I want to add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It asks which agent group and isolation level to use.

say_en.text: Change this group's trigger word to 'hey bot'.
say_en.note: It updates the wiring trigger rules for that agent group.

say_en.text: Add a calendar tool to the Tech agent group.
say_en.note: Likely runs /add-gcal-tool to wire the MCP server.
